ValidationRule.description: This rule will prohibit any sales user from changing an opportunity stage to a restricted value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WC_Sales_User', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WCSalesTeamMgr', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Broker_Relations_Manager', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WC_Sales_User', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Renewal_Sales', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Renewal_Sales_Manager' ), OR( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Approved - MCA'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Submission - MCA/ALT'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Conversion'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Funded'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Internal Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'NF Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Resubmit'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Syndication'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'NF Withdrawn'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Re-Review') ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'NF Decline'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Internal Decline'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Pre-Qual MCA') ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Desktop Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Offer(s) Not Accepted'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Re-Process') )) ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales may not change the opportunity to the Stage selected. Please try again or contact Operations for more information.
